sentences.en: I just want to live simply and happily, without troubles.
sentences.zh: 我只想简单快乐地生活，没有烦恼。

sentences.en: Happily, everyone rescued from the sea are alive and well.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，从海里获救的人都平安无事。

sentences.en: You only have one life. Live it happily and successfully.
sentences.zh: 你只有一生。要活得幸福成功。

senses.zh: 幸福地；快乐地；幸运地；恰当地
